QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_40

question.text: Per SEBI Circular dated September 10, 2025, Angel Funds are required to report investment-wise valuation and cash-flow data to benchmarking agencies starting from which financial year?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 7.6 footnote 69: SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/AFD/AFD-PoD-1/CIR/P/2025/128 dated September 10, 2025 mandates Angel Fund reporting from FY 2025-26 onwards. The Trap: FY 2023-24 and 2024-25 are prior — Angel Funds were previously exempt. FY 2026-27 is too late. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the same Angel Fund reporting trigger. XIX-A distributors handling Angel Fund LP onboarding must be aware. Manager's Pro-Tip: If you manage an Angel Fund under Cat I, set up benchmarking data pipelines by Q3 FY 2025-26 — late setup often leads to unaudited-data reporting which agencies reject, triggering SEBI follow-up.
